parts.prompt:
Salt dissolves in water but sand does not. After stirring both with water, which step separates the sand?
A. Evaporate the entire mixture
B. Decant before sand settles
C. Crystallise the dissolved salt

parts.canonical_answer:

Distractor explanations: A: Evaporating the whole mixture leaves sand mixed with the recovered salt. B: Decanting before settling may carry sand into the liquid. C: Crystallising before filtration traps sand with the product.
marking_guidance: Correct option D (1). D. Filter the stirred mixture. Filtration retains insoluble sand while the salt solution passes through. Distractor explanations: A: Evaporating the whole mixture leaves sand mixed with the recovered salt. B: Decanting before settling may carry sand into the liquid. C: Crystallising before filtration traps sand with the product. No mark for more than one selected option.
